instance.finding_key: packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts:333::cross-sheet unbounded refs (`sheet2!a:a`) are deliberately left unexpanded, but now lex as reference tokens and reach `tosrefs`, which throws `invalid reference` — breaking `builddependantsmap` for the entire sheet, not just that cell. the `iscrosssheetref(r) continue` guard in the loop body cannot help: the generator throws while producing the value, before any iteration happens.

finding.summary: Cross-sheet unbounded refs (`Sheet2!A:A`) are deliberately left unexpanded, but now lex as REFERENCE tokens and reach `toSrefs`, which throws `Invalid Reference` — breaking `buildDependantsMap` for the ENTIRE sheet, not just that cell. The `isCrossSheetRef(r) continue` guard in the loop body cannot help: the generator throws while producing the value, before any iteration happens.
finding.evidence: memory.ts:333 `for (const r of toSrefs(extractReferences(expandUnboundedRanges(cell.f, bounds))))` — expandUnboundedRanges skips cross-sheet (formula.ts:364), so `SHEET2!A:A` survives; toSrefs (coordinates.ts:236-243) takes the cross-sheet branch, `localRef='A:A'` contains ':', so `parseRange('A:A')` → `parseRef('A')` → throw (coordinates.ts:336-338). Same three sites in the diff's other store: yorkie-store.ts:574, :586, :602. Callers do not catch: sheet.ts:1063 (`setData`) and :1144 (`removeData`) only have `finally { endBatch() }`, so one cell containing `=SUM(Sheet2!A:A)` makes every later edit in the sheet throw.

decision.reason: I could not verify this finding because the repository working tree is inaccessible from my tools. Read of /repo/packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts failed ("file does not exist"; cwd reported as /tmp/eval-item-hRoO8Z/repo), and Grep for `expandUnboundedRanges|isCrossSheetRef|toSrefs`, Glob `**/*.ts`, Glob `**/*`, Glob `*`, Glob `**/package.json` (parent dir), and a catch-all `Grep .` over the repo root all returned zero files/matches. With no file readable I cannot check any load-bearing claim: the call shape at memory.ts:333, whether expandUnboundedRanges skips cross-sheet refs, whether toSrefs/parseRange/parseRef throws on 'A:A', whether the generator throws before the `isCrossSheetRef(r) continue` guard can run, or — critically for an `already-guarded` refutation — whether sheet.ts:1063/:1144 or yorkie-store.ts:574/586/602 wrap these calls in try/catch. Refuting requires a named ground plus file:line locations I actually read; "my tools returned no files" is a tooling failure, not evidence of `not-present`. The changed-file list authoritatively includes memory.ts, coordinates.ts, formula.ts, sheet.ts and yorkie-store.ts, so `pre-existing` is unavailable, and the described defect (a throw inside a generator consumed outside the diff, propagating through callers that only have `finally { endBatch() }`, duplicated in a second store in another package) is squarely in the blast-radius lane at critical impact. Uncertainty keeps the finding.
